representation.name: ABO O neighborhood q1
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
mkdir work
cd work
tar -xzf "$(inputs.archive.path)"
plink2 --pfile match.genotypes.1.1 --chr 9 --from-bp 133257450 --to-bp 133257850 --export A --out oneigh > plink.log 2>&1 || true
{
  printf 'PVAR_WINDOW\n'
  grep '^9[[:space:]]' match.genotypes.1.1.pvar | grep -E '^9[[:space:]]+133257[4-8][0-9][0-9][[:space:]]' || true
  printf '\nRAW\n'
  if [ -f oneigh.raw ]; then cat oneigh.raw; else printf 'NO_RAW\n'; fi
  printf '\nLOG\n'
  cat plink.log
} > ../oneigh_window.txt
